guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 賽普勒斯街高架橋 1957 年通車，1989 年 10 月 17 日洛馬普列塔地震中崩塌，42 人罹難
加州耐震設計準則 1.7 版：固定基礎單柱排架位移韌性需求 μ_D ≤ 4，多柱排架 ≤ 5
同一準則要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量 μ_c 至少為 3
加州準則採用 A706 鋼筋期望降伏強度 68 ksi（475 MPa）
加州準則柱主筋比上限 0.04 A_g、下限 0.01 A_g
加州準則 2.1 版以理想化塑性彎矩的 120% 作為超強度彎矩
PEER 結構性能資料庫收錄超過 400 組鋼筋混凝土柱反覆載重試驗
1999 年 921 集集地震（Mw 7.7）造成台灣約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損
1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線共有 10 跨高架段在 3 處側倒
factsEn: The Cypress Street Viaduct opened in 1957 and collapsed in the Loma Prieta earthquake on 17 October 1989, killing 42 people
Caltrans SDC 1.7 limits displacement ductility demand to μ_D ≤ 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and ≤ 5 for multi-column bents
The same criteria require each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity μ_c of at least 3
Caltrans criteria use an expected yield strength of 68 ksi (475 MPa) for A706 reinforcement
Caltrans criteria limit column longitudinal steel to between 0.01 A_g and 0.04 A_g
Caltrans SDC 2.1 takes the overstrength moment as 120% of the idealised plastic moment
The PEER Structural Performance Database holds over 400 cyclic tests of reinforced concrete columns
The 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake (Mw 7.7) badly damaged about 102 major bridges in Taiwan
In the 1995 Kobe earthquake 10 spans of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled at 3 locations
timeline: 1971　聖費爾南多地震暴露橋柱圍束與剪力不足，加州開始修訂橋梁耐震設計
1989　洛馬普列塔地震中賽普勒斯街高架橋崩塌，加速以容量設計為核心的準則
1995　阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線多處單柱高架段側倒
1996　日本修訂道路橋示方書耐震設計編，強化韌性設計並引入殘留位移檢核
1999　台灣 921 集集地震約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，推動規範修訂與既有橋梁補強
timelineEn: 1971 — The San Fernando earthquake exposes inadequate column confinement and shear, and California begins revising bridge seismic design
1989 — The Cypress Street Viaduct collapses in the Loma Prieta earthquake, accelerating criteria built on capacity design
1995 — Several single-column elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route topple in the Kobe earthquake
1996 — Japan revises the seismic part of its highway bridge specifications, strengthening ductility design and adding residual-displacement checks
1999 — Taiwan's Chi-Chi earthquake badly damages about 102 major bridges, driving code revision and retrofit of existing bridges
codes: 加州運輸局耐震設計準則（Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria, SDC）
AASHTO LRFD 橋梁耐震設計指引規範
日本道路橋示方書 V 耐震設計編
交通部公路橋梁耐震設計規範
codesEn: AASHTO Guide Specifications for LRFD Seismic Bridge Design
Japanese Specifications for Highway Bridges, Part V: Seismic Design
Taiwan Seismic Design Specifications for Highway Bridges (MOTC)
landmarks: 賽普勒斯街高架橋（奧克蘭）
阪神高速道路 3 號神戶線
I-880 尼米茲高速公路賽普勒斯改線段
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
guides.concept: 從 1989 年賽普勒斯高架橋、1995 年阪神高速神戶線與 1999 年 921 地震的橋墩破壞出發，建立容量設計層級與位移韌性需求，量化圍束箍筋、塑鉸長度與轉角容量，再處理箍筋與續接器施工、反覆載重試驗、震後殘留漂移、塑鉸區腐蝕與既有橋墩的剪力退化評估，說明為何塑鉸只能出現在預先選定、詳細配筋且可檢查的位置。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from pier failures in the 1989 Cypress Viaduct, the 1995 Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route and the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake, build the capacity-design hierarchy and displacement-ductility demand, quantify confinement, plastic-hinge length and rotation capacity, then cover hoop and coupler construction, cyclic testing, residual drift, hinge-zone corrosion and shear degradation in existing piers, explaining why plastic hinges may form only at preselected, well-detailed and inspectable locations.
procedure: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。容量設計把柱端彎曲塑鉸設為唯一的延性保險絲，其他構件（剪力、帽梁、基礎、梁柱接頭、支承與錨定）都以塑鉸可能達到的超強度彎矩來設計，確保它們保持彈性。這樣即使地震遠超預期，破壞仍以可預測、可修復的彎曲變形出現，而不是脆性剪斷或基礎破壞。

對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。韌性需求越高，塑鉸轉角越大、損傷越重；加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版把固定基礎單柱橋墩的 μ_D 限制在 4、多柱排架限制在 5，並要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量至少為 3。限值的目的是讓需求與容量之間保有餘裕，同時把震後損傷控制在可修復範圍。
塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。圍束同時防止縱向主筋在反覆載重下挫屈，以及提供剪力強度。圓形斷面用螺旋筋圍束效率最高，矩形斷面則需要繫筋把箍筋的長邊拉住，否則箍筋向外彎曲，圍束作用只在角落有效。
實際塑性變形分布在柱底一段區域內，為了計算方便，以等效塑鉸長度 L_p 把曲率集中成一個轉角：L_p 一部分來自柱高（彎矩梯度），一部分來自主筋在基礎中的應變滲透，因此與主筋直徑及降伏強度有關。塑鉸轉角容量等於（極限曲率 − 降伏曲率）乘以 L_p，再乘以柱高換算為塑性位移。塑鉸區內不允許主筋搭接，因為搭接在反覆大應變下會滑脫，這正是許多早期橋墩在柱底搭接處破壞的原因。
塑鉸區配筋最密：大直徑主筋、密集螺旋筋、繫筋與基礎頂層筋交錯，模板內空間有限，施工者常為了方便澆置而放寬箍筋間距、縮短彎鉤或省略繫筋，這些小變更都直接降低圍束效果。混凝土方面，粒料粒徑與坍度必須讓混凝土流過密集鋼筋並充分搗實，否則柱底出現蜂窩，保護層與核心之間的握裹不良。施工縫若設在塑鉸區內，界面也會成為弱面。
柱主筋要在塑鉸區發展到超過降伏的大應變，因此續接與錨定必須比鋼筋本身更強：機械續接器要能讓鋼筋在續接器外降伏並硬化，而不是在續接器內拉脫；主筋伸入基礎或帽梁的長度與彎鉤方向，要確保塑鉸應變滲透段不會拔出。梁柱接頭內鋼筋交錯最密，接頭剪力需要專門的箍筋與垂直筋，施工順序也要讓接頭混凝土能一次澆置密實。
塑鉸設計公式來自大量柱試體的反覆載重試驗：在固定軸力下，以逐級增加的層間位移角（漂移比）反覆推拉柱頂，每級重複數圈，記錄力—位移遲滯迴圈、裂縫、保護層剝落、主筋挫屈與斷裂的順序。太平洋地震工程研究中心（PEER）的結構性能資料庫收錄了 400 多組反覆載重柱試驗，台灣的國家地震工程研究中心也以反力牆設施進行實尺寸或大比例橋柱試驗。試驗的用途是校驗分析模型與破壞準則，而不是證明單一設計。
韌性設計允許塑鉸損傷，因此震後要能快速判斷橋墩還能不能用：可觀察的指標包括裂縫寬度、保護層剝落範圍、主筋外露或挫屈，以及柱的殘留傾斜。殘留漂移比是決定能否修復的關鍵，因為傾斜的柱在重力下產生 P-Δ 二次彎矩，降低後續地震的安全餘裕；1995 年阪神地震後日本在設計中引入殘留位移檢核，即是為了避免大量傾斜橋墩只能拆除重建。
柱底塑鉸區通常在地面或水面附近，最容易受到乾濕循環、鹽分、除冰鹽或河水沖刷磨耗；箍筋位於最外層，比主筋更早腐蝕。箍筋斷面一旦因腐蝕減少，圍束能力與剪力強度同步下降，而這兩者正是韌性設計賴以成立的條件。因此耐久設計（保護層厚度、混凝土品質、裂縫控制、表面保護）在塑鉸區不只是延壽問題，而是維持耐震性能的必要條件。
依舊規範設計的橋墩常見三種韌性缺陷：圍束箍筋太少、柱底主筋搭接、以及剪力強度不足。混凝土提供的剪力強度會隨塑鉸轉動而退化，因為斜裂縫張開、骨材互鎖減弱，所以即使柱在小變形時剪力足夠，進入韌性範圍後也可能剪斷，短柱尤其危險。評估流程是先求彎曲容量對應的剪力需求，再與隨韌性退化的剪力容量比較，判斷破壞模式；結果決定是否需要鋼板包覆或纖維複材補強，並寫入交接與維護文件。
procedureEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. Capacity design makes the column-end flexural plastic hinge the only ductile fuse, and designs every other element (shear, cap beam, foundation, beam–column joint, bearings and anchorages) for the overstrength moment the hinge can develop, so that they stay elastic. Even in an earthquake far beyond expectation, damage then appears as predictable, repairable flexural deformation rather than brittle shear or foundation failure.

For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. Higher demand means larger hinge rotations and heavier damage; Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria version 1.7 limits μ_D to 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and 5 for multi-column bents, and requires each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity of at least 3. The limits keep a margin between demand and capacity and hold post-earthquake damage within a repairable range.

The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. Confinement also stops longitudinal bars buckling under reversed loading and supplies shear strength. Circular sections confined by spirals are the most efficient; rectangular sections need cross-ties to restrain the long sides of the hoops, or the hoops bow outward and confine effectively only at the corners.

Plastic deformation actually spreads over a zone at the column base; for convenience an equivalent plastic-hinge length L_p concentrates curvature into one rotation. Part of L_p comes from the column height through moment gradient and part from strain penetration of the bars into the footing, so it depends on bar diameter and yield strength. Hinge rotation capacity equals ultimate minus yield curvature times L_p, converted to plastic displacement through the column height. Lap splices are not allowed in the hinge zone because they slip under reversed large strains, which is why many older piers failed at base lap splices.

The hinge zone has the densest reinforcement: large longitudinal bars, closely spaced spirals, cross-ties and the footing's top mat all intersect in limited form space, and contractors are tempted to widen hoop spacing, shorten hooks or omit cross-ties for easier placing, each of which directly reduces confinement. For concrete, aggregate size and slump must let it flow through congested steel and be fully compacted, or honeycombing appears at the column base with poor bond between cover and core. A construction joint placed within the hinge zone also becomes a plane of weakness.

Column bars must develop strains well beyond yield in the hinge zone, so splices and anchorages must be stronger than the bars: a mechanical coupler must let the bar yield and strain-harden outside the coupler rather than pull out inside it, and the length and hook direction of bars extending into the footing or cap beam must ensure the strain-penetration zone does not pull out. Beam–column joints have the most congested steel; joint shear needs dedicated hoops and vertical bars, and the construction sequence must let joint concrete be placed densely in one pour.

Plastic-hinge design formulas come from many cyclic column tests: under constant axial load the column top is pushed and pulled through increasing drift ratios, several cycles per step, recording hysteresis loops and the sequence of cracking, cover spalling, bar buckling and fracture. The Pacific Earthquake Engineering Research Center's Structural Performance Database holds over 400 cyclic column tests, and Taiwan's NCREE tests full-size or large-scale bridge columns against its reaction wall. Tests calibrate analysis models and failure criteria rather than proving a single design.

Ductile design accepts hinge damage, so after an earthquake engineers must judge quickly whether a pier can stay in service: observable indicators include crack width, extent of cover spalling, exposed or buckled bars and the column's residual tilt. Residual drift is the key repairability criterion because a tilted column carries second-order P-Δ moment under gravity, eroding safety for later earthquakes; after the 1995 Kobe earthquake Japan introduced residual-displacement checks into design to avoid large numbers of tilted piers that could only be demolished and rebuilt.

The base hinge zone usually sits near ground or water level, where it is most exposed to wetting and drying, salts, de-icing salts and abrasion by river flow; hoops lie outermost and corrode before longitudinal bars. Once corrosion reduces hoop area, confinement and shear strength fall together, and those are exactly the conditions ductile design relies on. Durability design (cover, concrete quality, crack control and surface protection) in the hinge zone is therefore not just about service life but a prerequisite for keeping seismic performance.

Piers designed to older codes commonly show three ductility deficiencies: too little confinement, lap splices at the column base and inadequate shear strength. The concrete contribution to shear degrades as the hinge rotates, because diagonal cracks open and aggregate interlock weakens, so a column with adequate shear at small deformation can fail in shear once it enters the ductile range, short columns especially. Assessment first finds the shear demand corresponding to flexural capacity, then compares it with shear capacity degrading with ductility to identify the failure mode; the result decides whether steel or fibre-reinforced-polymer jacketing is needed and is written into handover and maintenance records.
evidence: 設計審查時要求一張「延性構件與能力保護構件」對照表，列出塑鉸位置、M_p、M_o 與各能力保護構件的強度比；變更柱配筋時，必須同步重算所有能力保護構件。
相鄰排架的有效勁度比應盡量接近（例如以墩高、斷面或基礎埋深調整），設計報告須列出每座排架的 Δ_D、Δ_y、Δ_c 與 μ_D，作為審查與後續評估的基準。
塑鉸區的箍筋必須是封閉箍或連續螺旋，彎鉤以 135 度彎入核心並有足夠延伸長度，或採焊接封閉箍；圖面要單獨繪出塑鉸區的箍筋間距與範圍，不得以一般區配筋替代。
柱主筋優先採用通長或塑鉸區外的機械續接，基礎內錨定長度與彎鉤方向依設計圖施作；施工前召開配筋協調會，確認塑鉸區、施工縫與續接位置。
把塑鉸區配筋查驗列為澆置前的停留點，未經監造簽認不得澆置；任何配筋變更（間距、彎鉤、續接）須經設計者書面同意，並記入竣工圖。
evidenceEn: Design review requires a table of ductile versus capacity-protected members listing hinge locations, M_p, M_o and each protected member's strength ratio; any change to column reinforcement triggers recalculation of all capacity-protected members.

Keep effective stiffness ratios of adjacent bents close, adjusting pier height, section or foundation embedment, and list Δ_D, Δ_y, Δ_c and μ_D for every bent in the design report as the baseline for review and later assessment.

Hinge-zone hoops must be closed hoops or continuous spirals, with 135-degree hooks anchored into the core with adequate extension, or welded closed hoops; drawings show hinge-zone spacing and extent separately and must not substitute general-zone detailing.

Prefer continuous column bars or mechanical couplers outside the hinge zone, and build footing anchorage length and hook direction exactly as drawn; hold a reinforcement coordination meeting before construction to confirm hinge-zone, construction-joint and splice locations.

Make hinge-zone reinforcement inspection a hold point before casting that cannot be passed without the inspector's signature; any change to spacing, hooks or splices needs the designer's written approval and goes into the as-built drawings.
pitfalls: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。
1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中崩塌的賽普勒斯街高架橋，柱缺乏足夠的環向圍束以防止爆裂，上下柱之間也缺少鋼筋連接；圍束不足的柱在保護層剝落後核心壓碎、主筋外凸挫屈，強度與軸向承載同時喪失。
箍筋間距在施工中被放寬、彎鉤只做 90 度或繫筋遺漏，地震時保護層剝落後箍筋彎鉤張開，核心混凝土失去圍束，主筋挫屈；這種缺陷在完工後完全被混凝土覆蓋，只有大地震才會暴露。
只做單調推覆或圈數太少的試驗，會高估韌性；試體縮尺後若沒有同比例縮小箍筋與粒料，圍束與握裹行為與原型不同，試驗得到的漂移容量可能偏樂觀。
河川或沿海橋墩柱底保護層被沖刷磨耗、箍筋鏽斷，平時外觀只是局部剝落，地震時塑鉸區卻提早剪力破壞或主筋挫屈，原本設計的韌性容量已不存在。
pitfallsEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity.

The Cypress Street Viaduct, which collapsed in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake, had columns lacking enough hoop confinement to prevent bursting and upper columns not tied to the lower ones with reinforcement; in poorly confined columns, once the cover spalls the core crushes and bars buckle outward, losing both lateral strength and axial capacity.

Hoop spacing widened during construction, 90-degree hooks or missing cross-ties let hooks open once the cover spalls in an earthquake, so the core loses confinement and bars buckle; such defects are completely hidden by concrete after completion and are exposed only by a major earthquake.

Monotonic pushover tests or too few cycles overestimate ductility; if hoops and aggregate are not scaled with the specimen, confinement and bond differ from the prototype and the measured drift capacity may be optimistic.

At river or coastal piers, abraded cover and corroded-through hoops at the column base look like minor spalling in service, yet in an earthquake the hinge zone fails early in shear or by bar buckling, because the designed ductility capacity no longer exists.

related.title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
related.titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
related.transfer: 可遷移「容量設計與破壞層級」與「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Quasi-static cyclic column testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強則以以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse; FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers centres on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「超強度彎矩 M_o」與「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋墩纖維複材耐震補強，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overstrength moment M_o” and “Three deficiencies of old piers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
history.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
history.text: 1971 年聖費爾南多地震後，加州開始檢討橋柱圍束不足的問題；1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中奧克蘭雙層的賽普勒斯街高架橋崩塌、造成 42 人死亡，其柱缺乏圍束且上下柱未以鋼筋連接，促使加州運輸局全面推動以容量設計與位移韌性為核心的耐震設計準則。1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線多處高架段側倒，日本隨後大幅修訂道路橋耐震設計並引入殘留位移檢核；1999 年台灣 921 集集地震約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，也推動了公路橋梁耐震設計規範與既有橋梁補強。Priestley、Seible 與 Calvi 等研究者以大量柱試驗建立塑鉸長度與圍束模型，成為今日韌性設計的基礎。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: After the 1971 San Fernando earthquake California began addressing inadequate column confinement; in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake Oakland's double-deck Cypress Street Viaduct collapsed, killing 42 people, its columns lacking confinement and its upper columns not tied to the lower ones, prompting Caltrans to adopt seismic criteria built on capacity design and displacement ductility. In the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled, and Japan then substantially revised highway bridge seismic design and introduced residual-displacement checks; in Taiwan's 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake about 102 major bridges were badly damaged, driving revisions to the highway bridge seismic code and retrofit of existing bridges. Researchers such as Priestley, Seible and Calvi built hinge-length and confinement models from extensive column tests, the basis of today's ductile design. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
